results: 1. nerve conduction studies: demyelinating sensorimotor neuropathy
2. whole exome sequencing: heterozygous likely pathogenic FBLN5 c.1117C>T (p.Arg373Cys) - CMT1H
3. MRI brain with contrast: bilateral contrast enhancement and THICKENING of cranial nerves III through XII
4. MRI spine: symmetrical thickening of the lumbosacral nerve roots
dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease type 1H (CMT1H) caused by an FBLN5 mutation
Chronic inflammatory demyelinating polyneuropathy (CIDP)
Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease type 1A (CMT1A)
